findings.title: Drafted registered run cannot finish within its own timeout_min; stale cost fields remain
findings.detail: The spec's attempt-4 sizing (and the manifest's vm_sizing.registered_run) model the registered run at 170.2-246.4 h makespan and $104-151, with fits_timeout false in every scenario, while the spec still carries timeout_min 7200 (120 h), cost_estimate.registered_run_usd of about $75 and cpu_hours_est 110. This is disclosed and deferred to the founder, but as drafted the run would time out before producing a result.
findings.evidence: E011.dev_jobs.json vm_sizing.registered_run.by_scenario: all fits_timeout false (170.2/198.0/212.3/246.4 h); E011.yaml timeout_min 7200, cpu_hours_est 110, registered_run_usd text '$75'
findings.suggested_check: Before registration, set timeout_min, VM shape or run split from the vm_sizing model and update or mark superseded registered_run_usd and cpu_hours_est.

findings.title: Manifest per-draw r_d = 1.425 is the runner's optimistic placeholder but looks like a measurement
findings.detail: In dev, r_d() returns the window midpoint 0.5*(1.25+1.60)=1.425 for any D_j not yet solved, so every draw is recorded with r_d 1.425 and in_window true. Only the layout-level Wstar.provisional flag marks the stage as provisional; the per-draw records carry no flag.
findings.evidence: e011_run.py lines 613-616; manifest layouts.*.draws[*].r_d == 1.425 and attempt_log in_window true for all 16 draws
findings.suggested_check: Write r_d null (or add provisional: true) on draws whose R_D has not been solved.

findings.title: Physics risk: the degradation family's L1 target sits at the L2 window edge, and redraws cannot fix a systematic offset
findings.detail: The family aims L1(D)/L1(W*) at 1.3875 = 1.25 x 1.11, and all eight Case 4 draws sit at 1.390-1.421 (2R draw 1 at 1.309). If L_sub ratios fall further below L1 ratios than the assumed 1.11 factor on a layout, most draws land below 1.25. Redraws use the same family and target, so they would likely miss again, and F6 would make the run INVALID. This is pending the dev L2 run and is disclosed as pending.
findings.evidence: My recomputation of L1(D_j)/L1(W*) from manifest params: Case 4 1.390012-1.421243; spec frozen.degradation.target_ratio 1.3875, window [1.25, 1.60]
findings.suggested_check: From the burst rows, compare each seed's lat0.25 L_sub(D_j)/L_sub(W*) with its L1 ratio per layout before freezing target_ratio.

findings.title: Two dev-mode gaps: DC- alternative proxy solved only at 0.5 mm; Tj fallback cannot fire
findings.detail: Proxy sensitivity layouts, including dcm_alt_reading, are submitted only at screen_level lat0.5 (line 568), while W* is chosen by L_sub at 0.25 mm. So 'the L2 comparison of the two W*' the spec promises can only be made at 0.5 mm. Separately, the 2 K Tj fallback is gated on 'not provisional' (line 584), so it can never fire in dev. Here Tj(W*) < Tj(W) on both layouts, so there is no effect.
findings.evidence: e011_run.py lines 568-569 and 584; manifest tj_K 2R W 398.10 / W* 396.49 K
findings.suggested_check: Add lat0.25 for the dcm_alt proxy to the manifest if the founder wants that comparison at the production level.

findings.title: Some sources the note cites are not in the checkout
findings.detail: research/notes/e011-dev-run.md cites the stage checkpoints in research/o008_e011_dev/work/stages and the log research/o008_e011_dev/work_dev.log. Neither is tracked (only 5 files under research/o008_e011_dev). The improvement-curve brackets and the run-1 vs run-2 reproducibility claim cannot be re-derived from the repository. The manifest-level values can, and I re-derived the L1 ones.
findings.evidence: git ls-files research/o008_e011_dev -> 5 files (attempt2.md, attempt3.md, dev_summary.md, summarize.py, ...)
findings.suggested_check: Archive the stage checkpoints (content store) or state in the note that they are local-only.

findings.title: Distance from D_j and distance from W* are measured over different parameter ranges
findings.detail: changed_from_D uses range(4, len(v)) (indices 4-59) while changed_from_Wstar uses movable_indices (4-39). Since non-movable parameters never change (verified: 0 differences across all widen/compact/proxy_alone end points and W* vs D_0), the values are unaffected.
findings.evidence: e011_run.py line 683-684; my check: nonmovable diffs total 0
